Reject an empty signup email before submission.
1 Input →browser constraint check · 2 Invalid →show feedback · 3 Valid →request · 4 Server →validate again

Read the numbered stages from top to bottom. Input → browser constraint check; Server → validate
again.

<form>
 <label>Email <input type="email" name="email" required></label>
 <label>Code <input name="code" pattern="[0-9]{4}" required></label>
 <button>Submit</button>
</form>
Expected result: Empty email or non-four-digit code blocks normal submission.
Interview question: Why validate on the server too?
Answer: Clients can bypass HTML validation and send arbitrary requests.
Practice: Test an empty email, wrong code and valid input.
